# Photo runtime

Self-hosted, loaded only on request. UpscalerJS 1.0.0, ESRGAN Slim 1.0.0 (2x), TensorFlow.js 4.11.0.
Sources: https://github.com/thekevinscott/UpscalerJS and https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs .
All original licenses included. Original photos remain private; inference runs in the operator browser. AI may introduce texture artifacts; operator review is mandatory.
